art.title: The Starry Night
art.holder: Museum of Modern Art, New York
art.credit: Public domain · image via Wikimedia Commons (Google Art Project)
art.story: In June 1889 Vincent van Gogh painted the view from his window at the asylum in Saint-Rémy, just before dawn. But this sky is not quite what he saw: the stars swell into whirlpools of light, the moon blazes, and a dark cypress flickers upward like a flame. Below, a sleepy village keeps its lamps lit, its church steeple pointing at the storm of stars. Van Gogh thought the painting was a failure. Today it is one of the most loved pictures in the world.
